method: Wash the red lentils in warm (not hot) water 3—4 times, until the water runs almost clear.
Add the lentils to a pan, fill with water and allow to boil for 5—7 minutes, until tender, then drain.
Blend the tomatoes, ginger and garlic until smooth.
Meanwhile, heat up the oil. Add the cumin and, once it starts sizzling, add the cloves and chillies.
Add the blended tomatoes—be careful of the oil spitting.
Add the remaining spices and the salt, and mix thoroughly.
Cook for 3—5 minutes, until the sauce darkens and thickens.
Add the coriander stems and the cooked lentils, mix thoroughly and cook for a few minutes.
Add the coriander leaves and taste for seasoning.
